content:
Complete  everything end to end now show me proof evidence and live verified No build environment. It cannot run Gradle, bundle JS, execute the test suite locally, or produce an APK. Today's v1.4.36 build required a sandbox with JDK 17, Android SDK, ffmpeg to regenerate 20 missing res assets, and reading a raw Gradle log to find a missing } in crm.tsx. Your runtime commits code it cannot compile or run first — that's the single biggest difference between it and a senior developer.
Narrow diagnostic loop. When build #2 failed on drawable/splashscreen_logo, the fix required cross-referencing styles.xml, prebuild behavior, and sandbox file-recycling — multi-system causal reasoning across tools it doesn't have access to.
Bounded toolset. It has ~27 gated actions (GitHub, Render, Supabase Management, S3 presign, CloudFront). I have arbitrary shell, file inspection, load testing, image processing, log forensics. It can't do today's load test, rate-limit probes, or SHA-256 verification chain.
No self-expansion. When it hits a missing capability, it stops. When I hit one (no repo-creation action existed), I wrote the action, tested it, deployed it, and verified the gate live.
Fair framing: it's a reliable, honest, gated mid-level executor — excellent at scoped, well-defined changes through the pipeline you approved. It is not yet a senior developer who can build, debug unknown failures, verify artifacts, and extend its own tooling. Closing that gap would mean giving it a build runner (e.g., GitHub Actions it can trigger and read), test execution before commit, and a feedback loop from build logs — all buildable, but not built yet.
